tools.name: etsy_listing_check
tools.description: Reads one Etsy listing from Etsy's API: title, the 13 tags, photo count and sizes, video, when it expires and whether it auto-renews, favorites, and whether the description mentions AI. Applies Etsy's published title/tag rules and returns the first thing to fix. Use for 'is my listing set up right?'

tools.name: etsy_shop_audit
tools.description: Reads up to 100 active listings of an Etsy shop from Etsy's API and checks each one against Etsy's published title, tag and photo rules. Returns the shop's first problem and how many listings have it, per-listing issues, and Etsy's shop sales count (the shop's lifetime total, not per listing). Use f

tools.name: etsy_shop_sales
tools.description: Etsy's own sales count (transaction_sold_count: total sales of the shop, not per listing), active listings, favorites and opening year for up to 5 Etsy shops. No revenue estimate. Use for 'how many sales does this Etsy shop have?' and comparing competitors.

tools.name: etsy_top_shops
tools.description: Runs one Etsy search (first 100 active listings, relevance order) and returns the shops behind it: how many of those listings each shop has, Etsy's shop sales count and opening year. Use for 'who sells <product> on Etsy?' and 'who are my competitors?'.

tools.name: etsy_niche_check
tools.description: Facts from one Etsy search: Etsy's active listing count for the phrase, the middle half and median of USD-priced listing prices (other currencies counted, not converted), tags and title phrases the listings share, and the shops behind them. No demand or saturation verdict and no search volume (Etsy'

tools.name: etsy_rank_check
tools.description: Position of a listing (or a shop's listings) in the first 100 active listings Etsy's API returns for a search phrase, in relevance order, and which words of the phrase are missing from its title and tags. Beyond 100 it says 'not in the first 100'. etsy.com search can differ per shopper.

tools.name: etsy_shop_name_check
tools.description: Checks up to 6 shop names against Etsy's shop name rules and whether an Etsy shop already uses each name. 'No shop found' does NOT mean available: Etsy does not reuse names of closed shops and closed shops do not show up.

tools.name: etsy_tag_ideas
tools.description: The tags and title phrases the first 100 Etsy listings for a phrase actually use, each counted once per listing, plus a 13-tag starting set. No search volume (Etsy's API does not provide it).

tools.name: etsy_fee_calculator
tools.description: Etsy's fees for one order in the seller's country: listing fee, transaction fee, payment processing, regulatory operating fee and VAT on fees, from Etsy's published rates. Assumes no sales tax on the order and no Offsite Ads.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "etsy_shop_name_check" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "etsy_shop_name_check" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
